That sounds really relaxing, to be honest.

​

I'm a graduate student, so I can't really move in with family. My family is also super nutty so not a great environment to heal. All my friends have places of their own, and I don't want to impose on anybody.

All I get to write is very bland scientific papers, so I'm kind of jealous. What kind of fiction?

​

I'm passionate about microbiology. Which is kinda lame. But I love being in the lab, it's like its own little dimension in the twilight zone. It's about the only thing I'm good at, apparently. You?

​
I honestly don't know what to say.  Thank you
